# Metto - Tehran Metro Route Planner & Map

Metto (متو) is a free, fast, and offline-capable web app for navigating the Tehran Metro system.

## Features

- **Route Planner**: Find the fastest route between any two metro stations with transfer info, travel time, and stop count
- **Station List**: Browse all 100+ stations across 7 metro lines with schedules, amenities, and maps
- **Nearby Stations**: Find the nearest metro station using GPS, filter by amenities (WiFi, elevator, parking, etc.)
- **Interactive Map**: Satellite and schematic views of the full Tehran Metro network

## API Endpoints

- [Route Planner](https://metto.ir/api/route?from=Tajrish&to=Darvazeh Sharq) - Plan a route between two stations by name or GPS coordinates
- [Station List](https://metto.ir/api/stations) - List all stations, filterable by line or search query
- [Station Details](https://metto.ir/api/station/Tajrish) - Get full details for a single station
- [Nearby Stations](https://metto.ir/api/nearby?lat=35.804&lng=51.433) - Find nearest stations to GPS coordinates

## MCP Server

An MCP server is available for AI assistants (Claude, etc).

Tools: get_route, list_stations, get_station, find_nearby

## Documentation

- [OpenAPI Spec](https://metto.ir/openapi.json) - Machine-readable API documentation
